message.content: Based on the conversation, Viper has expressed interest in increasing their stamina. Specifically, Viper mentioned that they have noticed an increase in their stamina during workouts. To potentially further enhance this improvement, Viper suggested incorporating interval training into their cardio routine. Interval training involves alternating short bursts of high-intensity exercise with periods of rest or low-intensity activity. This method is known to help build endurance without overstressing the body. Viper emphasized that interval training could be a great way to keep workouts interesting and maintain or even improve stamina over time.
